raw.query: WITH ledger AS (SELECT id, raw AS note FROM ledger_entry WHERE id = 978), v_dim_runs AS (SELECT r.run_id FROM v_dim r WHERE r.window_name = 'aggregate' AND r.is_current = true AND r.forecast_model = 'timesfm' AND r.run_id = 'a12:week_encoder_timesfm'), current_cost AS (SELECT cr.run_id, cr.forecast_model, cr.cost_ratio FROM v_cost_ratio cr JOIN v_dim_runs dr ON cr.run_id = dr.run_id WHERE cr.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8'), matrix_cost AS (SELECT cr.forecast_model, cr.cost_ratio FROM v_cost_ratio cr WHERE cr.window_name = 'aggregate' AND cr.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' AND cr.run_id IN ('factorial:forecast_p90_chronos_rho15_L30', 'factorial:forecast_p90_toto_rho15_L30')), accuracy AS (SELECT model, mode, resolution, AVG(wape) AS avg_wape FROM forecast_metrics WHERE span = 'common' AND candidate = 'point' AND h = -1 AND resolution = '15s' AND model IN ('chronos', 'toto') GROUP BY model, mode, resolution) SELECT (SELECT note FROM ledger) AS ledger_note, (SELECT json_build_object('model', forecast_model, 'cost_ratio', cost_ratio) FROM current_cost) AS timesfm_current, (SELECT json_object_agg(forecast_model, cost_ratio) FROM matrix_cost) AS matrix_costs, (SELECT json_object_agg(model || '/' || mode, ROUND(avg_wape::numeric, 5)) FROM accuracy) AS accuracies;
raw.observed: Chronos-2 aggregate cost ratio is 0.614 (0.619 at L=15s, which rounds to the 0.62x headline), while Toto-2.0 is 0.610 and TimesFM-2.0 is 0.603. Ledger 978 states Chronos-2 is 120M parameters and Toto-2.0 is 2.5B (making Toto 20.8x larger). On accuracy, at 15s cadence, Toto/cov (WAPE 0.54665) beats Chronos/cov (WAPE 0.55169).
raw.claimed: Chronos-2 (120M params) is smallest; Toto-2.0 is 20x larger; headline uses cheapest forecaster.
raw.evidence: Ledger 978 and v_cost_ratio show Chronos-2 (120M params) is the smallest model (Toto-2.0 is 2.5B, or 20.8x larger) and quotes its 0.62x headline cost ratio, which represents the cheapest/smallest model which is slightly less accurate than Toto (0.55169 vs 0.54665 WAPE).
